summary: Earth Twin is a project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to identify locations on Earth that closely resemble potential permanent Moon base locations and environments on Mars. By comparing geographical features, terrain, temperature, climate, and environmental conditions, the project helps identify suitable Earth-based analog sites for studying extraterrestrial environments. These locations can support research, testing, and preparation for future human exploration and habitation on the Moon and Mars.
details: Earth Twin is a project that compares different locations on Earth with the environmental conditions of the Moon and Mars. It uses geographical, terrain, temperature, and climate data to identify Earth locations that resemble potential lunar and Martian base sites. The project aims to help researchers understand extraterrestrial environments and find suitable locations on Earth for testing technologies and preparing for future space missions.
